hypothesis: A falsifiable statement about the improvement this wave will prove.
whyThisMatters: Why this is worth spending a wave on.
requiredEvidence: Observable evidence that would demonstrate success.
nonGoals: Work this wave must not expand into.
sacredConstraints: BOW law that cannot be weakened to obtain a pass.
repairCondition: Evidence that the direction remains promising but incomplete.
rollbackCondition: Evidence that the implementation caused more harm than value.
killCondition: Evidence that the hypothesis should be abandoned or materially redesigned.

iterationBudget.reason: Why this investment is proportionate. Use 0 when token measurement is unavailable.
